# Relationship Case Service v0.1 validation

Qualified locally on 2026-08-26 with ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and the current supplied component set.

Validated against:
- Relationship Case v0.2
- Alchemy Objects v0.8
- Institutional Policy v0.8
- ooRexx Queue Fabric v0.9-dev4
- ooRexx Crypto v0.1

Eight executable acceptance tests pass:
1. CASE.OPEN / ATTACH_ELEMENT / TRANSITION / GET / FOR_SUBJECT service commands;
2. semantic command idempotency and command-id conflict detection;
3. Alan-style external-pressure policy barrier and restricted staff projection;
4. theoretical CRM reference boundary without authority promotion;
5. in-process Queue Fabric command/reply/event adapter;
6. Runtime Registry lifecycle-shaped service module;
7. append-only service-state recovery, durable outbox retry and restart-safe idempotency;
8. typed persistent Queue Fabric command recovery and post-restart event emission.

`rexxc` translation passes for the service core, CRM boundary, persistence adapter, Queue Fabric adapter and runtime module.

Durability semantics are intentionally at-least-once for service-event delivery. Stable service event IDs support downstream de-duplication. A state persistence failure faults/quiesces the current service instance rather than allowing further divergent mutations.
